notes.title: 03.08 Update
notes.content:
[h3][b]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/b][/h3]
[*] [b][Game Mode][/b] In Clan Match and Ranked Match, the Kill Cam has been removed so as to not give away the enemies position. Instead, you will instantly begin spectating a teammate.
[*] [b][Game Mode][/b] Melee Weapons have been removed from Crossbow Battle
[*] [b][UI][/b] Fixed a bug that incorrectly displayed [Season 5] whilst queuing for a Clan Match
[*] [b][Item][/b] The Zulu PP-2000 has been added to the Collection Box Coupon.
[*] [b][Item][/b] Fixed a bug that caused the Nebula Vector to have 2 magazines.
[*] Daily Log-In Rewards have been updated
[*] Fixed an issue with Daily Mission localization.
[*] The penalty for abandoning a Ranked Match has been increased from 5 > 30 minutes. Repeat offences increase the penalty by 30 minutes.
